Author: Rayla Petal
Name: PoseKit
Description: Animation Assistance Plugin, offset your character's pose, save named presets and replay them, auto-discover Penumbra pose mods, and manually resync emote timing with a partner.
Punchline: Offset, save, and replay poses; auto-discover Penumbra animation mods.
Changelog: Fix a false self-conflict and unplayable options on mods with stale default_mod.json data (e.g. Kissing While Standing), let every dropdown option be selected and played in one click, and fix an off-by-one that showed GroundSit/Sit/Doze poses one stage higher than the mod actually labels them.
